statement.p: Parameterize the line through P = \left(-1,-5\right) and Q = \left(0,-1\right) so that the points P and Q correspond to the parameter values t = 15 and 16.

static.solution:
\overrightarrow{0P} = -1 \vec i - 5 \vec j from the origin to the point P and the displacement vector \overrightarrow{PQ} = \vec i + 4 \vec j from P to Q.
\vec r(t) = \overrightarrow{OP} + (t - 15)\overrightarrow{PQ} or \vec r(t) = (-1 + \, (t - 15))\vec i + (-5 + 4\, (t - 15))\vec j.
